decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans received on the 10.12.13 (Existing Floor Plans SV01; Existing Rear; Elevation SV03; Existing Section A-A SV04; Existing Section B-B SV05; Existing Section C-C SV06;  Proposed Ground floor Plan PL01; Proposed Rear Elevation PL03; Proposed Section C-C PL05 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to house and replacement of flat roof to a pitch roof.
